title: Act: Add trackedDependencyPaths and parseGitLsFiles helpers
summary: Extend trackedNodeModules.ts with cache-aware filter, parser and checker
description: Add helpers so the guard can flag node_modules and .vite paths and read git ls-files -z output.
acceptance_criteria: trackedDependencyPaths flags node_modules and .vite segments only
checkTrackedFiles(run) throws via assertion when git lists such paths

steps.action: Add exported function trackedDependencyPaths(paths: string[]) returning paths whose '/'-split segments include 'node_modules' or '.vite'.
steps.expected: Function returns only dependency or cache paths

steps.action: Add exported parseGitLsFiles(output: string): string[] that splits on '\0' and drops empty strings.
steps.expected: NUL output becomes a path list

steps.action: Add exported checkTrackedFiles(run: GitRunner): void that calls run(['ls-files','-z']), parses it, and throws Error with count and first 10 paths when trackedDependencyPaths is non-empty.
steps.expected: Throws only when a dependency/cache path is tracked
